suppliers.search: Search code, name or VAT number

empty.title: No suppliers yet

noAccess.title: You don't have access to suppliers
noAccess.body: Seeing suppliers needs the permission "See customers and suppliers". The Buyer, Sales and Finance roles have it; ask an administrator.

new.title: New supplier

new.after: It opens as a prospect: approve it before its first purchase order.

block.stops1: No new purchase orders to this supplier.
block.stops2: Orders already sent stay as they are; receipts show a warning.

suppliers.blockedBanner: Blocked since {date}: no new purchase orders.

side.noContacts: Nobody receives POs: purchase orders cannot be emailed yet.

address.emptyBody: Purchase orders and invoices name the registered office; goods are collected from the pick-up address.

contacts.title: Contacts and what they receive
contacts.emptyBody: POs cannot be emailed until one contact receives POs.

identity.none: No tax identity yet: purchase orders and its invoices name its tax numbers.

warning.NO_TAX_IDENTITY: No tax identity: an invoice or a purchase order needs its tax numbers.
warning.NO_REGISTERED_ADDRESS: No registered office: the invoice names its seat (sede legale).
warning.FISCAL_DRAWER: No SDI code or PEC: invoices go to its fiscal drawer (0000000) and a copy by mail.
warning.VIES_NOT_PROVEN: No valid VIES check: its sales are not zero-rated until a check answers valid.
warning.TAX_COUNTRY_DIFFERS: The tax identity is of another country than the record: check which is right.
warning.NO_ORDERS_CONTACT: Nobody receives orders: give a contact the Orders role and an email.
warning.NAME_TOO_LONG: The legal name is longer than the 80 characters an e-invoice carries.
warning.NOT_LATIN1: The name or the registered office has characters an e-invoice cannot carry.

customers.vies: EU businesses without a valid VIES check
customers.viesHint: Their sales are not zero-rated yet
customers.blockedHint: No new quotes, orders or shipments

vies.title: VIES check
vies.notYet: Not checked yet. Check now: the answer is kept as the proof.
vies.noAnswer: VIES didn't answer (member state unavailable) — not a refusal. Try again.
vies.recheck: Re-checks are not scheduled yet: a proof counts for {days} days, so check again before a zero-rated sale.
vies.notApplicable: VIES checks EU VAT numbers outside Italy. This party has none to check.
vies.refused: VIES was not asked: the connection may not be set up, or our company has no VAT number. Nothing was recorded.
vies.noneToCheck: No EU business in this list has a VAT number to check.
vies.afterCreateFailed: Created. VIES didn't answer yet: check again from Tax & terms.

meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE: No EU VAT number outside Italy to check.
meaning.UNCHECKED: Never checked: a sale is not zero-rated until a check answers valid.
meaning.VALID: Valid in VIES; the proof counts for {days} days after the check.
meaning.EXPIRED: The last valid check is older than {days} days: check again before a zero-rated sale.
meaning.INVALID: VIES answered not valid: no zero-rated sale; Italian VAT applies until a new check answers valid.
meaning.HELD: No answer from VIES and no current proof: held, check again later.

done.VALID: VIES: {name} is valid. The answer is kept as the proof.
done.INVALID: VIES answered that the VAT number of {name} is not valid.
done.ERROR: VIES didn't answer for {name}: not a refusal. Try again later.
